_help: Races we fetch from their own timer, listed by hand (Turritt is not a source). One entry per race: name (with year), date, source (eq, raceresult or ultimate) and event id. eq: every stage of the event is read, riders are matched by EQ id or name; only events with results on EQ count (many are sign-up only). raceresult: list (the list's name on the event page), cols = [place, name, time] columns in that list (default [2, 3, 5]; road and criterium lists give the gap after the winner). ultimate: distance (default 1). type overrides the type guessed from the name. skip_classes: regex of classes or stages without a time. Rider-linked EQ results (the rider's EQ history) and SSK Cup (sskcup.py) are found without this file.
